title: XaocMail ClickFix Campaign Drops Phantom53 and HavoX Across Latin America, Asia, and Europe
description: The XaocMail ClickFix campaign is a sophisticated multi-stage phishing operation by a Russian-speaking threat actor targeting organizations in Latin America, Asia, and Europe. It uses the XaocMail phishing platform to deliver malicious MSI payloads via social engineering lures named ClickFix. The campaign employs Phantom53, a DNS-over-HTTPS command-and-control framework, and Havoc, a post-exploitation toolkit, leveraging Cloudflare Workers infrastructure for stealth and resilience. The attackers use advanced techniques including domain generation algorithms, scheduled tasks with Python virtual environments for persistence, and AI-assisted development for rapid iteration. Targets include sectors such as technology, finance, education, government, logistics, and manufacturing. The operation demonstrates advanced operational security and infrastructure abuse to evade detection.
